retained_failures.scope: Blank XR framebuffer in AR, VR and Portal Network regression
retained_failures.observed: Real opaque framebuffer readback returned zero opaque pixels and a null output target despite two reported eye views. Frame counters alone were not accepted as rendering evidence.
retained_failures.cause: The application installed setAnimationLoop after XRManager.setSession, replacing r177's internal camera/output-target wrapper.
retained_failures.correction: Install the application frame callback before setSession; r177 captures and wraps it. Let its synchronous session-end cleanup restore internal ownership before clearing the application callback.
retained_failures.unchanged_assertions: Strict real stereo framebuffer completeness, pixel diversity and opacity checks remain; no synthetic image substituted.
